title: Health-sector union strike march in Santiago
location: Santiago, Plaza de la Dignidad to La Moneda
threshold_50_evidence: Radio Universidad de Chile reports about 3,000 health workers at the Santiago march.

start_date.summary: Published 12 November; source describes first day of 48-hour action on Thursday 12.

location.summary: Plaza de la Dignidad to La Moneda, Santiago.

demands.summary: Sectoral benefits/budget and reversal of health-services undersecretary appointment.

state_response.summary: No repression described in this event; no absent-response inference beyond source scope.

notes: First day of a nationally called 48-hour strike; Santiago assembly and march are a distinct local site action. Demands named: COVID recognition bonus, health budget, user-service bonus, technicians in Health Code, and reversal of undersecretary appointment.
open_questions: Official mapping of benefit and budget demands into codebook categories?

title: Health-worker union strike march in Concepción
location: Concepción, O’Higgins Avenue toward regional municipality
threshold_50_evidence: BioBioChile reports approximately 500–1,000 at the distinct Concepción march, exceeding 50. Do not add to Santiago’s separate 3,000 estimate.

location.summary: Central Concepción along O’Higgins toward municipal/regional offices.

organizer.summary: Public health workers convened by Fenats.

demands.summary: National health-sector strike context; precise Concepción-specific demands are not itemized locally.

protester_violence.summary: No protester violence reported in reviewed local passage.

state_response.summary: Partial traffic interruption; no other state response established.

notes: Distinct local action on first day of national 48-hour strike. S004 establishes Fenats convening and local route/count. S001 describes the nationwide strike and policy demands, but these were not itemized by S004 for Concepción; do not project all details as local demands.
open_questions: Local correspondence between Concepción march and each nationwide policy demand?

title: Health-sector union march to Health Ministry in Santiago
location: Santiago, former Central Post Office to Ministry of Health
organizer: Confusam, Fenats, Fenpruss and nursing federation organizations (reported)
threshold_50_evidence: No crowd count is provided in the opened account; movement/number of arrests are not a crowd-size proxy.

location.summary: From former Central Post Office to Ministry of Health, Santiago.

demands.summary: Primary-care funding, COVID bonus, government commitments.

threshold_50.summary: No numeric attendance evidence; threshold unresolved.

notes: A discrete November 24 march during continuing health-sector industrial action. Article reports demands over primary-care funding, COVID bonus and government commitments. A separate Valparaíso action on Nov25 was announced but its occurrence is unverified.
open_questions: Does any permitted local source provide a simultaneous attendance count?

title: Health-sector union banner action and march in Santiago
location: Santiago, near Plaza Baquedano along Alameda
threshold_50_evidence: The report describes a banner action and march but supplies no crowd estimate; threshold remains unresolved.

start_date.summary: Published Friday 27; event described as Thursday, 26 November.

location.summary: Near Plaza Baquedano, march along Alameda.

demands.summary: Primary-care funding, COVID and user-service bonuses.

protester_violence.summary: No incident reported in reviewed source.

notes: BioBioChile published 27 Nov and dates the action to Thursday 26 Nov. It reports continued health-worker protest and demands for primary-care funding, COVID bonus and user-service bonus. No incidents were reported in the reviewed article.
